description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android application demonstrating swipe-to-refresh functionality using SwipeRefreshLayout. It manages a ListView that gets refreshed with random data when the user performs a swipe gesture or selects the refresh menu item. The class includes setup for the layout, adapter, refresh listener, menu handling, and an AsyncTask to simulate data refresh.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshLayoutBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates the use of SwipeRefreshLayout with a ListView, allowing users to refresh content with a swipe gesture or menu action.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and indicates that it has an options menu.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and sets up references to SwipeRefreshLayout and ListView.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the ListView adapter and sets up the refresh listener for SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items, triggering refresh if the refresh menu item is selected.

methods.name: initiateRefresh
methods.description: Starts the background task to refresh data and shows the refresh indicator.

methods.name: onRefreshComplete
methods.description: Updates the ListView data with new items and stops the refresh animation.
